title: Add the engine's one-command installer with pre-install version resolution
summary: Ship an installer for the engine that performs a per-user install into a private prefix, writes a `forgel` launcher on PATH through a marked profile block verified in a fresh login shell, is idempotent on re-run, supports uninstall, and prints the version it installed. Before installing, it reports the version provided by a configured target source or ref without changing anything, so another installer can compare against an installed engine and decide whether to install. Source, ref and interpreter configuration come from its environment.
plan_goal: Make Forgel and Forgel Code install and run as one working pair: give the engine `forgel` its own installer, add a mode of the Forgel Code installer that installs both binaries together (offered by default in the README, idempotent — when the engine is already present it compares versions and installs only a strictly newer one), and introduce a declared minimum supported engine version for Forgel Code, checked at startup, so a missing or too-old engine produces a clear actionable message instead of `engine forgel: executable not found: forgel`.
